newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian stabs wife and four children to death.
newsitem.headline: Austrian stabs wife and four children to death.

text.p: A 32-year-old Austrian stabbed his estranged wife and four children to death then failed in a suicide attempt, police said on Thursday.
The 26-year-old woman and her children, aged from one to five, died of their injuries at their home in the western province of Tyrol, a police spokesman said.
The father was taken to hospital with serious injuries after calling police to his former flat in the village of Langkampfen in the early hours of the morning.
